Good morning, everyone. This is an update for warehouse staff. Reusable crates will replace cardboard cartons for local deliveries. The trial showed that the crates protect fragile products more effectively. Please keep the following instructions in mind. Record the number of empty crates returned by each driver. Crates containing chemical products must be stored separately from food containers. Finally, the logistics team will review the return records before ordering more crates. Thank you for your attention.
For questions about this update, please contact Visitor services. The information desk chart shows where to go.

transcript:
Good morning, everyone. This is an update for farm customers. Vegetable orders can be collected from a refrigerated locker near the market. Customers working late often miss the staffed collection hours. Please keep the following instructions in mind. Enter the code from the order confirmation at the locker. Orders must be collected within one day because locker space is limited. Finally, uncollected produce will be donated to the community kitchen. Thank you for your attention.
For questions about this update, please contact Visitor services. The information desk chart shows where to go.

Subject: Cold storage training
For: food warehouse workers

transcript:
Good morning, everyone. This is an update for office drivers. Employees can release unused parking reservations to a shared daily pool. Reserved spaces were often empty while visiting colleagues could not park. Please keep the following instructions in mind. Cancel a space reservation on days when working elsewhere. Released spaces are assigned in the order requests are received. Finally, the reception team will notify drivers when a space becomes available. Thank you for your attention.
For questions about this update, please contact Visitor services. The information desk chart shows where to go.

Good morning, everyone. This is an update for neighborhood residents. Garden waste will be collected separately from household rubbish. The council plans to turn suitable plant material into compost. Please keep the following instructions in mind. Place leaves and small branches in the marked reusable container. Soil, stones, and plastic bags must not be placed in the container. Finally, collection crews will leave a notice if unsuitable material is found. Thank you for your attention.
For questions about this update, please contact Visitor services. The information desk chart shows where to go.

transcript:
Good morning, everyone. This is an update for long-term residents. The library is recording local residents' memories for an oral history collection. Written records do not capture every aspect of everyday life in the town. Please keep the following instructions in mind. Contact the project librarian to arrange an interview. Participants may restrict public access to parts of their recording. Finally, the librarian will provide a consent form before recording begins. Thank you for your attention.
For questions about this update, please contact Visitor services. The information desk chart shows where to go.
translation: 情境：文化休閒／Library oral history project。聽力依序包含新安排、原因、應採取的行動、限制及後續處理；各題解析標示英文依據。

B: The shop is testing evening delivery within a limited service area. Customers near the shop have requested later delivery times.

A: We should also mention the restrictions.

B: Yes. A seed exchange will take place at the garden center.
A: Why is that happening?
B: Gardeners often have more seeds than they can use in a season.
A: What do we need to tell people?

B: Volunteers will organize packets by plant type before the exchange opens.
A: For questions about this update, please contact Visitor services. The information desk chart shows where to go.

Team chat — Product photographs
09:10 — Mia: The photographer can come on Wednesday morning. Are the display samples ready?
09:13 — Leo: The blue and green samples are ready. The white one failed the final inspection, so a replacement is being made.
09:16 — Mia: We need all three colors in the same lighting. Can the replacement be finished by Wednesday?
09:20 — Leo: Production says Thursday is the earliest. The photographer is also free Friday morning.
09:24 — Mia: Let's take that slot. Please keep the approved samples covered until then.
09:27 — Leo: I'll confirm the new appointment and label the faulty sample so it isn't used by mistake.
